To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the overintakes of vegetables in which nitrate exceeds the national standard is harmful to health, and that the immersion, blanching and peelling of vegetables before consumption can effectively decrease the level of nitrite and nitrite.

the effectiveness of preconsumption treatment methods, namely immersing in different liquids, blanching and peeing, on nitrate and nitrate in typical vegetables in Wuhan City was evaluated spectrometrically according to the Chinese National Standard.
the effectiveness of several preconsumption treatment methods in removing nitrate or nitirte from vegetables was spectrometricaly evaluated.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the removal of nitrates and nitrites from vegetables, using different pre-consumption treatment methods.
the removal of nitrate from vegetables by means of immersion, blanching, or peeling.
the effectiveness of several preconsumption treatment methods in reducing the levels of nitrates and nitrites in vegetables, which is a very important issue for food safety.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the levels of nitrites in vegetables can be effectively lowered by the methods of peeling,blanching,and soaking in vinegar,saline,or fruit and vegetable washing detergent before consumption.
the nitrate content in vegetables can be reduced by 20% to 40% by blanching,peeling and soaking in vinegar or washing detergent before consumption.

pre-consumption treatment methods such as immersion in different liquids (vinegar, fruit and vegetable washing detergent and saline), blanching, and peeling can be effectively used to reduce the nitrate and nitrites levels in vegetables.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the nitrate and nitrate levels in vegetables can be reduced by preconsumption treatment,which is of great significance to the safety and health of consumers.
the nitrate and nitrate content in vegetables can be reduced by preconsumption treatment,which can be used as a method to reduce the risk of nitrate and/or nitrite toxicity.

nitrate and nitrites in vegetables could be effectively reduced by immersing them into vinegar,fruit and vegetables washing detergent or saline solution before consumption,blanching them or peeling the outer layer of root and stem vegetables,fruit vegetables and eggplant before consumption.

the levels of nitric oxide in vegetables could be effectively reduced by peeling and blanching,while the level of nitrite in vegetables could be reduced by peeling,immersion in vinegar and fruit and vegetable washing detergent,or by blanching.
